---
title: "Examples"
---

# Variables, Tables, and Keywords

Single table

``` stata
getcensus S2701, year(2024)
```

Single variable

``` stata
getcensus B19013_001, year(2024)
```

Multiple variables from a single table

``` stata
getcensus DP02_0053 DP02_0054 DP02_0055 DP02_0056 DP02_0057, year(2024)
```

Multiple variables from more than one table

``` stata
getcensus S1701_C03_001 S2701_C05_001, year(2024)
```

Keyword

``` stata
getcensus medinc, year(2024)
```

# Years and Samples

Single year

``` stata
getcensus B19013, year(2024)
```

Multiple years

``` stata
getcensus B19013, years(2022/2024)
getcensus B19013, years(2019 2021 2024)
```

Samples (default is 1)

``` stata
getcensus B19013, year(2024) sample(5)
getcensus B19013, year(2013) sample(3)
```

# Geographies

Types (default is state)

``` stata
getcensus B19013, year(2024) geography(us)
getcensus B19013, year(2024) geography(county)
getcensus B19013, year(2024) sample(5) geography(sldu) statefips(26)
```

Within a state or set of states

``` stata
getcensus B19013, year(2024) statefips(11)
getcensus B19013, year(2024) geography(county) statefips(04)
getcensus B19013, year(2024) geography(congressional district) statefips(24 51)
getcensus B19013, year(2024) sample(5) geography(metro) statefips(06)
```

With specific GEOIDs

``` stata
getcensus B19013, year(2024) geography(metro) geoids(47900)
getcensus B19013, year(2024) geography(county) statefips(24) geoids(005 510)
getcensus B19013, year(2024) sample(5) geography(tract) statefips(01) countyfips(001) geoids(020100)
```

Geographic components

``` stata
getcensus B19013, year(2024) geocomponents(H0)
getcensus B19013, year(2024) geocomponents(01 43) statefips(13)
getcensus B19013, year(2024) sample(5) geography(us) geocomponents(92)
```

# Catalog

All variables in tables of a given product type

``` stata
getcensus catalog, year(2024) product(DP)
```

Variables from a single table

``` stata
getcensus catalog, year(2024) table(S0901)
```

Variables matching a search term

``` stata
getcensus catalog, year(2024) search(children) product(ST)
getcensus catalog, year(2024) search(educational attainment) table(S1701)
```
